title: Skedda vs Officely
summary: Compare Skedda and Officely for desk booking, hybrid office coordination, workplace analytics, integrations, policy controls, and space management.
body_markdown:
## Choosing the Right Workflow for a Hybrid Office


Choosing **office management software** in 2026 affects how employees plan office days, reserve desks, coordinate with colleagues, and manage shared space. The right tool should support office attendance without creating another disconnected task.


Skedda and[Officely](https://getofficely.com/) take different approaches:


- **Skedda** is a workplace management platform with web, mobile, Microsoft Teams, and Slack access, plus booking tools, custom rules, roles, workplace intelligence, and space-management features.
- **Officely** is a hybrid work platform built around Slack and Microsoft Teams. Employees can plan office days, coordinate with colleagues, and book desks within the tools they already use.


The better choice depends on the company’s communication tools, booking requirements, policy controls, and approach to hybrid work.


If a company is already reviewing[Skedda alternatives](https://getofficely.com/skedda-alternatives) , this comparison explains where each platform fits.


## Skedda and Officely at a Glance

Skedda presents desk, meeting-room, office-space, lab, and parking-space booking as platform use cases. It also lists custom rules, roles, workplace intelligence, visitor management, integrations, and interactive floor plans among its features.[\[1\]](https://www.skedda.com/)


## The Main Difference: Platform-Led or Chat-First Workflow?


### Skedda’s Platform-Led Booking Experience


Skedda centers its experience on a dedicated workplace platform, with additional access through its mobile app, Microsoft Teams app, and Slack integration. Employees can use those surfaces to check availability, see who is in, receive notifications, and complete supported booking workflows.


This structure can suit companies that want a dedicated workplace system with detailed space controls. Buyers should test the exact Slack or Microsoft Teams journey they expect, because available actions vary by integration and plan.


### Officely’s Chat-Based Workflow


Officely makes Slack or Microsoft Teams the primary place for office coordination. Employees can choose office days, see which colleagues plan to attend, and reserve desks without moving to a separate workplace application.


That workflow supports:


1. Planning an office day.
2. Checking which teammates are coming in.
3. Coordinating seating through neighborhoods or team-based areas.
4. Reserving a desk.
5. Reviewing attendance and office-use information.


Officely does not use interactive floor plans. Its focus is hybrid team coordination, desk booking, office attendance tracking, and workplace visibility inside the communication tools employees already use.


For teams that rely heavily on Slack or Microsoft Teams, this approach can reduce the number of steps required for[desk booking software](https://getofficely.com/blog/choose-best-desk-booking-software) .


## Feature Comparison for Hybrid Offices


### Desk Booking and Hot-Desking


Both platforms support desk booking and flexible seating. The practical difference is how employees complete the booking and coordinate their day.


**Officely supports:**


- Desk reservations through Slack or Microsoft Teams.
- Hot-desk booking for flexible seating arrangements.
- Visibility into which colleagues are attending.
- Team neighborhoods that help employees sit near one another.
- Office-day planning before employees arrive.
- Attendance and booking information for managers and workplace teams.


This makes Officely a practical choice for companies replacing assigned seating with hot desks. Employees can plan an intentional office day instead of booking a desk without knowing who else will be there.


**Skedda supports:**


- Desk booking through its web platform.
- Custom booking rules and roles.
- Booking for additional resources, including rooms, labs, offices, and parking spaces.[\[1\]](https://www.skedda.com/)


Skedda may suit organizations that need detailed resource-booking rules or visual space selection. Officely is better suited to teams that want hot desk booking to happen in the same place where they coordinate daily work.


### Meeting Rooms and Shared Spaces


A **meeting room booking system** should show room availability, prevent conflicting reservations, and fit the way employees already schedule office time.


Both platforms support meeting-room booking:


- **Skedda** includes meeting-room booking among its workplace use cases.
- **Officely** supports meeting-room reservations alongside desk booking and office attendance planning. Employees can manage room and desk needs through the Slack or Microsoft Teams workflow.


The choice depends on the broader operating model. Skedda is a stronger fit when meeting rooms are one part of a wider resource-booking system that includes labs, parking, and other spaces. Officely fits teams that want room reservations connected to hybrid scheduling and daily office coordination.


### Integrations and Employee Access


Integrations matter because they determine where employees complete routine actions.


Workflow Skedda Officely


Slack desk booking Supported; confirm plan and workflow Supported within Slack


Slack attendance visibility Who’s-in visibility available Office-day and colleague visibility


Microsoft Teams desk booking Native Teams app available Supported within Microsoft Teams


Floor-plan access Available through Skedda’s platform Not available


Dedicated booking platform Central to the Skedda experience The chat surface is the primary booking workflow


SSO and tenant setup Verify requirements for the selected integration Designed around the existing Slack or Teams environment


Skedda’s integrations extend its dedicated workplace platform. Officely places the main booking workflow inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, which is useful for companies that want[hybrid work software](https://getofficely.com/blog/officely-for-hybrid-companies) to fit existing employee habits.


### Capacity Management and Office Utilization


Capacity management helps a company compare planned attendance with available desks, rooms, and office capacity. It can include:


- Expected office attendance.
- Desk bookings and usage.
- Occupancy trends by day.
- Capacity limits for offices or teams.
- Attendance against minimum-office-day expectations.
- Utilization information for workplace planning.


Officely provides visibility into attendance and office utilization. Managers can use this information to coordinate office days, identify busy periods, review desk usage, and make more informed decisions about flexible seating and office space.


Skedda provides workplace intelligence and has introduced Occupancy Insights for daily headcount, attendance trends, and return-to-office reporting.[\[2\]](https://www.skedda.com/blog/occupancy-insights)


This type of operational capacity management is different from a full IWMS or facilities-management suite. The comparison is most relevant to hybrid teams that need practical attendance and utilization information, rather than a broad real estate platform.


### Rules, Approvals, and Hybrid Work Policies


Hybrid workplaces often need more than a calendar. Managers may need to set attendance expectations, approve exceptions, or check whether teams are meeting minimum office-day requirements.


**Officely supports hybrid policy visibility through:**


- Attendance expectations for employees or teams.
- Approval workflows where managers need oversight.
- Visibility into attendance against minimum office-day requirements.
- Clearer tracking of return-to-office expectations.
- Information that helps managers apply workplace policies consistently.


This is workplace policy management, not legal or regulatory compliance software. The goal is to make hybrid expectations measurable and easier to administer.


Skedda lists custom rules and roles as platform features.[\[1\]](https://www.skedda.com/) That approach may be useful for organizations that need detailed controls over different resources, user groups, or booking conditions.


### Analytics and Workplace Insights


Reliable analytics depend on accurate booking and attendance data. Both platforms provide information that can help workplace teams understand office use.


**Officely analytics can help teams:**


- Review attendance patterns.
- Track office utilization.
- Identify popular office days.
- Compare desk demand with available capacity.
- Plan team seating and neighborhoods.
- Support decisions about office space and hybrid policy.


Skedda’s Occupancy Insights covers daily headcount, attendance trends, and return-to-office reporting.[\[2\]](https://www.skedda.com/blog/occupancy-insights)


A buyer should check which metrics each platform includes, how attendance is recorded, whether check-ins are required, and how reports can be exported or shared with People and Operations teams.


### Pricing, Contracts, and Implementation


Pricing and implementation terms can change, so buyers should confirm the current proposal before signing.


Skedda prices published plans per managed space and bills them annually. United States and Canada pricing starts at $249 per month for 35 spaces; EMEA and APAC pricing starts at $99 per month for 15 spaces. Buyers should confirm region, tier, included spaces, features, and add-ons before comparing total costs.[\[3\]](https://www.skedda.com/pricing)


For Officely, buyers should verify:


- Whether pricing is based on employees, active users, spaces, or another measure.
- Which Slack and Microsoft Teams features are included.
- Whether meeting-room booking and capacity controls are included in the selected plan.
- Whether approvals and policy visibility require a specific package.
- The implementation support and setup time.
- Renewal terms and cancellation requirements.


The[Officely vs. Skedda pricing comparison](https://getofficely.com/officely-vs-skedda) provides additional information for teams reviewing the two platforms.


## Which Platform Fits Different Office Models?


### Skedda May Suit Organizations That Need


Skedda can be a good fit for organizations that:


- Need a dedicated workplace booking platform.
- Manage multiple types of resources, such as labs, rooms, offices, or parking.
- Want custom rules and roles for booking.
- Prefer interactive floor plans for selecting space.
- Need detailed controls across a wider range of resources.
- Want workplace intelligence and occupancy reporting within a broader resource-booking system.


### Officely May Suit Hybrid Teams That Need


Officely is designed for companies that:


- Use Slack or Microsoft Teams as the main employee communication tool.
- Want desk booking and hot-desking inside that existing workflow.
- Need employees to coordinate office days with colleagues.
- Want team neighborhoods or seating coordination.
- Need visibility into office attendance and utilization.
- Manage minimum-office-day or return-to-office expectations.
- Prefer practical hybrid office software over a broader facilities platform.
- Want a workflow centered on team coordination rather than interactive floor plans.


Teams evaluating[workspace management software](https://getofficely.com/blog/maximize-office-efficiency-with-smart-workspace-management-software) should define whether their primary need is detailed space administration or day-to-day hybrid coordination.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Which option works best for Slack or Microsoft Teams teams?


Officely is the stronger fit when employees need to coordinate office days and book desks through Slack or Microsoft Teams. Skedda remains a dedicated workplace platform with integrations that buyers should evaluate against their preferred workflow.


### Which platform supports hot desking?


Both Skedda and Officely support hot desking. Skedda focuses on flexible resource booking and space selection. Officely connects hot-desk booking with office-day planning, colleague visibility, and team-based seating coordination.


### How does each product handle meeting rooms?


Both platforms support meeting-room booking. Skedda treats rooms as one of several bookable resources, alongside desks, offices, labs, and parking. Officely connects room reservations with desk booking and hybrid office scheduling inside Slack and Microsoft Teams.


### What does capacity management include?


Capacity management includes planned attendance, desk availability, occupancy trends, utilization, capacity limits, and visibility into minimum-office-day expectations. Officely centers this information on hybrid attendance and office-use planning. Skedda provides occupancy and attendance insights through its workplace intelligence features.


### Which option is better for hybrid-work policies?


Officely is better suited to teams that need to coordinate office days and review attendance against minimum-office-day expectations. Skedda may suit organizations that need detailed booking rules and roles across a wider range of resources.


### Does either product require an interactive floor plan or hardware?


Skedda includes interactive floor plans as part of its platform experience. Officely does not offer interactive floor plans and focuses on chat-based booking and attendance coordination. Buyers should confirm whether either product requires check-in hardware, QR codes, or other on-site equipment for their preferred workflow.


### What should buyers verify before choosing?


Buyers should verify pricing, billing frequency, space or user limits, implementation support, SSO requirements, Slack and Microsoft Teams functionality, room-booking features, reporting, approvals, and contract terms. A trial or guided demonstration should test the complete employee journey from planning an office day to booking a desk and reviewing attendance.

## The Right Choice Depends on the Workflow


Skedda and Officely both support desk booking, meeting-room booking, and workplace management. Their priorities differ.


Skedda is a strong option for organizations that need a dedicated platform with detailed booking rules, multiple resource types, and interactive floor plans. Its integrations should be evaluated based on the specific booking and workplace workflows required.


Officely is designed for hybrid companies that prioritize Slack or Microsoft Teams, hot-desking, team coordination, office attendance tracking, and practical utilization insights. It helps employees plan office days, find colleagues, reserve desks, and manage workplace expectations through the tools they already use.


For companies that want a simple, chat-based workflow for hybrid office coordination,[Officely](https://getofficely.com/) is a practical alternative to a broader multi-surface booking platform.
